title: Data of the event ext.monitor.problem.v1
description: A monitoring system problem on a node that the tenant catalog linked to a resource. The E5 adapter hands in only closed fields; the core sets the class and the item from the monitor_triggers row of the catalog by triggerid, for a trigger outside the catalog the class is unknown. There is no trigger name, no tags and no texts (MON-5, ING-4, INJ-16).

eventid.description: Problem id in the monitoring system.

resource.description: Resource of the tenant catalog found by monitor_host.

class.description: Class from spec/model/monitor-map.yaml; the core sets it from the catalog.

item.description: Item from the catalog row whose number the recheck reads; the core sets it.

severity.description: Severity of the monitoring system as a number 0-5.

values.description: Only numbers from the history of the item.
